note: First judgement 2026-11-19. Parent quote, RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA and the packet's header fields are not consistent with the selectors for the SA, it MUST discard the packet." Tested: "it MUST discard the packet". Gap: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA". The annotation splits by case, not by clause: Tested is an SA negotiated for one selector pair; Gap is a packet on one SA of a multi-pair or sibling set whose headers match a sibling's selectors and not this SA's. Boundary producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane, which installs the negotiated pair as the inbound XFRM state selector. Tests: TestRFC4301TunnelModeInboundSelectorsAreEnforcedByTheRequirePolicy delivers an in-selector packet first (a Fatal if not, so the drops are judged on a working SA), then for source outside, port outside and protocol outside the pair requires no delivery and the drop counters to move as exactly XfrmInStateMismatch +1 with XfrmInNoPols and XfrmInPolBlock unchanged, which isolates the discard at the SA's own selector rather than the SPD. TestRFC4301TransportModeInboundSADEntryDropsPacketsOutsideItsSelectors delivers the negotiated port, then requires a port-6000 packet undelivered with XfrmInStateMismatch +1 and an ICMP echo moving XfrmInStateMismatch by one; it does not assert the SPD counters, but the method notes a transport secpath with no matching inbound policy would otherwise be accepted, so the state selector is what discards. TestRFC4301NonErrorICMPOutsideSelectorsIsDiscarded sends an ICMP Echo Request on a tunnel SA whose outer headers miss the state selector: XfrmInStateMismatch +1, no header-decode error, Icmp InMsgs not counting it, beside a consistent ICMP error delivered as control. Polarity: discard of the inconsistent packet (positive) and delivery of the consistent one on the same SA (negative) are distinct assertions, so code that drops everything or nothing fails. The five discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc4301/RFC4301-5.2-11.json cover these units. Single-pair fixtures only: sibling-SA isolation is unproven. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
